title: Implement Filter Controller type registry and field-source foundation
description: Add the shared registry and binding resolver recommended by the robustness synthesis before starting per-filter visual polish.
objective: Make filter type metadata and field key resolution explicit, reusable, and backward-compatible.
expected_outputs: New reusable registry class or equivalent metadata provider.
New field binding resolver class or equivalent centralized resolver.
FilterSettings uses the resolver instead of owning parsing details directly.
Preset schema stores normalized field source and resolved key while preserving legacy key, field_binding, and field_binding_dynamic.
Editor config exposes filter type metadata for later reactive style-cadence work.
Implementation note documents the contract and what remains deferred.
acceptance_criteria: Existing widgets with only key still render with the same data-eit-key.
Existing widgets with plain field_binding still render with that key when it looks like a key.
Existing widgets with field_binding_dynamic still try Elementor tag parsing before falling back to manual key.
The new registry covers all current filter types.
No CPT dynamic tag provider is claimed as complete in this task.
No per-filter visual redesign is bundled into this task.
verification: PHP lint passes for changed PHP files.
JS syntax check passes for changed JS files.
composer validate --strict passes or limitations are documented.

budgets.complexity_budget: complex but bounded to shared foundation
budgets.context_budget: Filter Controller PHP settings/presets/assets and editor JS only
budgets.validation_budget: syntax, schema, composer, static diff checks

risks: Changing saved settings shape can break existing widgets if legacy keys are not preserved.
Dynamic tag behavior can be overclaimed if the implementation does not register Toolkit tags yet.
Adding registry metadata without using it can become dead architecture.
